summary: YOLO with Rails is the operating recipe; the linked patterns provide its isolation, budget, deterministic-check and review rails.

items.text: Run autonomous work inside a sandbox so the allowed capabilities and audit boundary remain enforceable even when nobody watches the tool calls.
Enforce token and cost ceilings outside the prompt so an unattended run stops at a hard resource boundary.
Require deterministic builds, tests and checks as hard postconditions before autonomous work can be accepted.
End unattended execution with an artifact-first review hand-off rather than continuous observation of the agent's working phase.
